target.title: fix(agents): preserve primitive tool result output
target.body:
Closes #99523

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running tools that return primitive string results could lose useful tool output when the agent prepared visible/model-readable result text. It also prevents successful structured output from being promoted into an error message when the result is not marked as an error.

## Why This Change Was Made

The tool result text extractor now preserves safe primitive string output before object-only result handling. Error message extraction now only falls back to normalized result text for results that are explicitly classified as tool errors, keeping successful structured output out of the error channel.

## User Impact

Users can now see and continue from tools that return plain string output, while successful tool results no longer appear as synthetic error text.

## Evidence

Focused regression test on this PR branch:

```text
node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.tools.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       37 passed (37)
```

Redacted runtime proof from a private gateway deployment after applying the same helper-path fix. Hostnames, IP addresses, local filesystem paths, and private deployment identifiers are intentionally omitted:

```text
primitiveString.visibleOutput=plain result
detailsStructured.visibleOutput={"details":{"status":"ok","result":{"messageId":"msg-1","delivered":true}}}
rootStructured.visibleOutput={"ok":true,"value":42}
imageOnly.visibleOutput=undefined
successfulStructured.errorMessage=undefined
```

This verifies the changed behavior beyond the unit test boundary: primitive string tool results produce visible output, safe structured output remains visible, image-only content is not converted into text, and successful structured output is not reported as an error.
